description_en: Queries batch data at the stream granularity for a specified accelerated domain name and supports multiple protocols
description_zh: 用于查询指定加速域名下的流粒度批量数据，支持多种协议
name: DescribeLiveUserStreamMetricData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name to query.

Only a single domain name can be queried. Specifying multiple domain names causes an error. If this parameter is left empty, the aggregation data of all accelerated domain names under the user is queried. If `AppName` and `StreamName` are not specified, data at the stream granularity is returned by domain name
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的加速域名。


仅支持单个域名查询，传多个域名将报错。域名为空时，查询用户下的所有加速域名的聚合数据。不指定 `AppName` 和 `StreamName` 时，按域名返回所有流粒度的数据
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The start time of the data to retrieve. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点，日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间。格式为：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the data to retrieve. The end time must be later than the start time, and the time span cannot exceed 1 day. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间需大于起始时间，不能相差超过 1 天；日期格式按照 ISO8601 表示法，并使用 UTC 时间。格式为：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The application name. Specify an application name to query data at the stream granularity for the corresponding application. If you specify `StreamName`, you must also specify `AppName`
parameters.help_zh: 应用名称。指定应用名称，查询对应应用流粒度的数据；指定 `StreamName` 时，必须指定 `AppName`
parameters.name: app_name

parameters.help_en: The stream name. If you specify `StreamName`, data at the stream granularity is returned for the specified `StreamName` under the specified `AppName`. If you specify `StreamName`, you must also specify `AppName`
parameters.help_zh: 流名称。指定 `StreamName` 时，按指定 `AppName` 的指定 `StreamName`，返回流粒度的数据（指定 `StreamName` 时，必须指定 `AppName`）
parameters.name: stream_name

parameters.help_en:
The stream protocol. Specify a stream protocol to query data for the corresponding protocol. Valid values: `flv`, `hls`, `rtmp`, `rts`, and `p2p`. You can specify multiple protocols separated by commas (`,`). No aggregation is performed on data for multiple protocols, which is output at the stream granularity.
The rts option can be used to query Real-Time Streaming (RTS) streams over the ARTC protocol.
When you use rts, you may need to additionally count the `xxx_AliRTS-opu` transcoded streams. Reason: When Real-Time Streaming (RTS) streams are played on the web, a transcoded stream with the `_AliRTS-opus` suffix appended to the stream name is generated for automatic transcoding, which generates transcoded stream data. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2948703.html
parameters.help_zh:
流协议名。指定流协议名查询流对应协议的数据，目前支持：`flv`, `hls`, `rtmp`, `rts`, `p2p`。支持查询多个协议的数据，协议间用 `,` 分隔，多个协议的数据不会聚合，按照流的粒度输出。
rts选项可查询artc协议的超低延时直播流。
使用rts可能需要额外统计xxx_AliRTS-opu转码流。原因：Web端播超低延时直播时，会生成流名后加上_AliRTS-opus后缀的转码流进行自动转码，产生转码流数据。详细请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2948703.html
parameters.name: protocol

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 5000
parameters.help_zh: 单页数据条数，单页最大5000
parameters.name: page_size

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

Count.description_en:
The total number of concurrent connections to the stream per minute.

Concurrent connections refers to the statistics of the number of connections to client processes under the same stream within a unit of time
Count.description_zh:
